# local_path: # Add one line per live site under web/{campaign}/ or web/hub/{slug}/.
# Same Bluehost account/SSH key for all. rsync has no --delete, so it only
# adds/updates — it never removes files already on the server.
# Content hubs (web/hub/*) are ALSO served from GitHub Pages at
# https://cabuzzard.github.io/dash/web/hub/{slug}/ — the Bluehost copy is what a
# custom domain points at. After adding a hub here you must also:
#   1. cPanel → assign the domain's document root to the remote_path below
#   2. worker.js → add the domain (apex + www, https) to HUB_ORIGINS, deploy
#   3. index.html → set `domain:` on the hub's HUB_SITES entry
# See CLAUDE.md "Content Hubs" for the full checklist.
